sql.query: SELECT es.id,es.statusName,es.systemCategory,es.displayOrder,es.colour,es.isActive,es.isDefault,CAST(COUNT(w.id) AS UNSIGNED) AS usageCount FROM tbl_event_statuses es LEFT JOIN tbl_workflows w ON w.eventStatusId=es.id AND w.tenantId=es.tenantId WHERE es.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') AND r.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=es.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) GROUP BY es.id ORDER BY es.displayOrder,es.statusName,es.id
